| Method | What it tells us | Key Take‑away |

| **SHAP Global Importance** | Measures how much each feature contributes on average to the **log‑odds** of the three classes. | Port, Payload_Size, and Status dominate the explanations; User_Agent and Request_Type are minor. |

## 2. Feature Influence on Attack vs. Normal  

### 2.1  Global View  
1. **Port** – consistently the single largest mean SHAP value across all three classes.  
   * High port numbers (≥ 5, i.e., 443, 4444, 6667, 8080, 31337) are strongly associated with the *Attack* classes (BotAttack & PortScan).
